outcome: NICU admission for at least one twin
cohort: The study included nulliparous and multiparous individuals with dichorionic twin pregnancies delivered between 2008 and 2021, excluding those with scheduled or elective cesarean, malpresentation, prior uterine surgery, fetal anomaly, gestational age at delivery <34 weeks, or multifetal reduction.
finding: Among nulliparous and multiparous individuals with dichorionic twins, induction of labor was not associated with decreased odds of vaginal delivery compared to spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Induction of labor and spontaneous labor showed similar odds of vaginal delivery for both nulliparous and multiparous individuals.
gest_age: Participants with gestational age (GA) at delivery <34 weeks were excluded; induced patients had a later GA at delivery, while spontaneous labor patients had a higher proportion of preterm delivery at <37 weeks.
